name: Verisk XactRestore
description: Connect Claude to Verisk’s XactRestore so restoration and remodeling professionals can build and refine estimates by simply describing the work that needs to be done. Powered by Xactware’s pricing and material data, Claude can create rooms, add and adjust line items, apply Quick Estimates, and surface pricing details inside trusted XactRestore workflows, while keeping contractors in control of every change. Make estimating faster, more intuitive, and easier to review so teams spend less time wrestling with software and more time helping homeowners.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Verisk XactRestore to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Verisk XactRestore to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://xactrestore-xactremodelserver-usw2-prod.propsol.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Verisk XactRestore MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verisk XactRestore lists 18 MCP tools, including SearchRemodRestorationRoofingJobs, GetRemodRestorationRoofingJobDetails, GetRemodRestorationRoofingOptionDetails, SearchRemodRestorationProjects, CreateRemodRestorationProject, SearchEstimateGroupsRoomsAreas, CreateEstimateRoomOrArea, UpdateEstimateRoomOrArea, DuplicateEstimateRoomOrArea, ArchiveEstimateRoomsOrAreas, SearchConstructionLineItemsCatalog, and GetConstructionLineItemPricing.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Verisk XactRestore in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Verisk XactRestore MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verisk XactRestore requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Verisk XactRestore is developed by Verisk Analytics, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
